hooks.command: printf 'This project follows the Compose conventions for its UI layer, split by what is being written. Read the one that applies, in full, before writing, reviewing or refactoring it: composables in %s/conventions/compose-conventions.md, ViewModels and their state in %s/conventions/compose-viewmodel-conventions.md, their tests in %s/conventions/compose-testing-conventions.md. If the app has a Desktop (JVM) target, also read %s/conventions/desktop-distribution-conventions.md in full before changing its startup, packaging or release workflow.\n' "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"
